name: Starlight Christmas

features.name: Pay anywhere
features.description: Clusters of 12 or more matching symbols anywhere on the grid win.

features.name: Multipliers to 500x
features.description: Multiplier symbols can land on any spin and boost the tumble's wins.

features.name: Tumbles
features.description: Winning symbols are removed and replaced, allowing several wins per spin.

review:
Starlight Christmas is the holiday edition of Starlight Princess, using the same characters on a 6×5 grid. Wins pay for clusters of 12 or more matching symbols anywhere, and tumbles clear winning symbols so new ones can drop in.

Multipliers worth up to 500x can land on any spin and apply to the tumble sequence they appear in. Pragmatic lists a 96.50% RTP. If you like Starlight Princess or Gates of Olympus, this plays in a very similar way with a festive theme, so it is an easy pick around the holidays.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
